Exercise 7. Personal answer. The tutor checks the correspondence with the registration and the attributions in the Italian summary. Exercise 8. a) To tell Šubrā Once, when she was little. If his mother was ill, the neighbors would cook for them; The one leaving left the key to the neighbors. Traffic and high buildings, but above all people have become busy, each on his own. Yāsmīn asks whether relations between neighbours have weakened; The mother responds "not exactly": there are still good people, but the pace is faster. Šubrā of once, but with the cell phone to call the children. b) The first takes the metro every day and saves an hour, but the ticket is increased; The lady does not take it because the metro does not arrive in her area, but she would take it if it arrived; The boy doesn't want to talk. A hypothetical question with law (say if he would come to his house?) Because even a refusal says something (some do not want to speak in front of the camera), even if it will not appear in the service. c) He loves to cook always (as a child he looked at his grandmother in the kitchen) and as an engineer he was not happy, every day the same thing. The father got angry and called him mad; The mother helped him and told him to try for a year. He opened a small restaurant in the center: it's not easy, but it goes. If you love something, do it, but with judgment. Unit verification. 1. iḥkīli ʿan ʿeltak. · 2. ēh ili ḫallāk tīgi Iṭālya? · 3. zayy ēh Masalan? · 4. ʾaṣdak ēh bi-ẓ-ẓabṭ? ·
